programme.title: Busses
programme.desc: Beep Beep, jump aboard with FIZZY & SUDS as they spend a day in the back seat of a beautiful big BUS. After all that country dust, they'll need a bubble bath - and we have just the machine for it!

programme.title: The Crew Builds Sierra Sparkle's Bedroom/ The Crew Builds a Water Ski Jump
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew have a sleepover with Sierra, but her favourite stuffy goes missing during a bedroom makeover! / When Mayor Greatway hurts her foot, the pups build a chair for her waterski stunt.

programme.title: Episode 15
programme.desc: Join the Takaro Tribe as they sing and dance their way through their magical alphabet forest, meeting friends and whanau as they go.

programme.title: Unicorn
programme.desc: Thanks to Mark's newfound interest in magic, Penny's horse drawing takes a turn for the fantastical.

programme.title: Hide and Seek
programme.desc: The friends are all playing hide and seek. Lou is the seeker, but he falls asleep before he can count to ten.

programme.title: Monkey Mechanic/ Seahorses And Wee Horses
programme.desc: George learns all about being a mechanic. / George tries to find seahorses on land.

programme.title: Episode 45
programme.desc: From the days of the week to multiplication and shapes - join The Wiggles and test your knowledge in this fun quiz with the Tree of Wisdom!

programme.title: Episode 46
programme.desc: Come sing and count with The Wiggles! Buddy is here to help you learn the two times table in a fun adventure filled with numbers.

programme.title: Pups Save an Antarctic Martian/ Pups Save the Maze Explorers
programme.desc: The search is on for Traveling Travis in Antarctica, where the direction-challenged explorer thinks he's on Mars. Alex, Mr. Porter, and a baby elephant who has followed them get lost in a huge maze.

programme.title: Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups vs. Three Super Baddies
programme.desc: At the Humdingers' hideout, the three super-baddies plot revenge on the Mighty Pups. Harold, Ladybird, and the Copycat want to gain control of the meteor that gives the pups their powers.

programme.title: Sugar Burger

programme.title: The New Leaf / Once Bitten

programme.title: The Orchid Grief / Forks and Knives Out

programme.desc: When George and Harold want to win the school Avocadgrow contest, they accidentally turn their science teacher into a giant avocado monster.

programme.desc: Rod's super-excited to sing at Rhonda's, until Chomps and Rocco take the piano! Margo the Monkey and the Banana Bandits break into Headquarters and try to take off with the HQ Command Flyer.

programme.desc: Ms. Marmalady makes sandwiches using Butterbean's magical flutter butter. / Cricket helps Jasper make deliveries, but she keeps making mistakes!

programme.desc: The little Reefies team up to compete in their ocean-famous piggyback race. Even Mr Flip joins in, but the race to the finish line turns unexpectedly fishy!

programme.desc: Dora throws her Abuela a super-secret quinceanera with a special dress, tiara, and shoes! Dora's friend Coco doesn't have a story for Story Time, so they go to the Tall Tale Tree in search of one.

programme.title: Swimming

programme.desc: Brrrmm Brmmm, here we go! FIZZY & SUDS get up to speed in the workshop and learn all about fast CARS. Even how they get spray-painted!
